pages.quiz:
WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

4. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.

5. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.

6. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.

7. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.

8. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

12. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Detailed drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Trends in woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Health and Safety in the Workshop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Portable Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

2. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. C — CPU

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

9. B — Information and Communication Technology

10. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Detailed drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Trends in woodwork; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Health and Safety in the Workshop; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Portable Power Tools; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
